set.body:
Problem: run structure is reconstructed downstream from SamplingFrame.blockLens and selected global row indices. That works for simple fits but does not make run-local time, session/run identity, censoring, and partition legality explicit at the dataset boundary.

Work: add a dataset-level temporal axis with typed global timepoint indices, run-local indices, run descriptors, and validated alignment to SamplingFrame. Expose partitions/views that fit and MVPA adapters can consume without rebuilding run semantics ad hoc.

Acceptance: selected timepoints can be mapped to run-local rows without unsafe Int plumbing; runwise/GLS partition construction has dataset-backed tests; censor/subselection behavior across multiple runs is covered; datasetJVM/test and datasetJS/test pass.
set.title: Dataset: own temporal axes and run partitions
